Laura / Olga — attaching our redline. Summary of changes and open items:

1) Data segregation (Section 4.2) — We accepted language that requires logical separation plus contractual assurance that Redwood won’t persist customer data beyond retention period; suggested explicit retention window. (Open: Northwyre to confirm retention window.)
2) Incident notification SLA (Section 7.1) — We proposed 72 hours for initial notification and a 5-business-day remediation plan; added process for urgent regulatory incidents. (Open: Northwyre to confirm acceptable initial notification timeframe.)
3) Subprocessors — We added the standard subprocessors clause with a 30-day notice for additions and a right to audit for critical subprocessors.

Marked non-negotiables: export controls language and encryption-at-rest requirement.

Attachments: Redline_MSA_olga_v2.docx (track changes)

Vendor portal note: Procurement, FYI — I created a vendor request with Finance (ticket #FIN-1189). They need a completed W9 and a point-of-contact email. Once W9 is uploaded they will issue vendor ID; that typically takes 2-3 business days.

Next steps / owners:
- Laura: confirm retention window + incident notification SLAs by 7/10
- Priyom: confirm payment terms and share finance approver (ETA 7/11)
- Olga: provide Redwood contact for portal uploads (done) and chase FIN ticket next week

Thanks,
